balls.text: Another boundary in that region. Bisects deep midwicket and long-on perfectly! Another missed yorker turns into a shin-high fully. Has happened often tonight. Tewatia missed out last time but this was powered and it hovered in the gap. Raced through the outfield
Pulled over midwicket. Got on the front dog to a 138ks shortish ball. Picked it from rib-height. Deep midwicket was too square and had no chance
Great bowling. Goes wide and full, bowls to his field. Guided to deep third
desp
Comes down and whips it but finds long-on. Just the single
Wide full toss. Stays deep in the crease and lifts it over cover. Talk about core strength. Has somewhat of a flat bat, doesn't give it much follow through. Gets it to the deep and takes two

Dances into the low fully on fifth, slaps it to the left of Curran at long-off. Tumbling stop, ball's parried to the left. Gill sees that as a chance to steal three. Scampers back, puts in the full-length dive. The perpendicular bat is past the crease when the bails are dislodged. Peak fitness.
Wide yorker. Tewatia falls across almost while brooming it to deep cover

Bumper, not given wide. Tewatia reviews. Bumper, pace on. Good change-up actually. Angling away over fifth stump. Tewatia's back foot was on fifth, front leg on middle. Was deep in the crease and he tried to pick it up with a hook. Tight call, not that far above but third umpire overturns the on-field call

Tewatia hares across within the crease and uses Harshal's wide lines to his advantage. Another yorker attempted too, so he was on one knee and swept it along the carper, behind square. His entry point might be a bigger debate now.
Another full toss that's too wide. Tewatia goes across and sighs as it was well beyond his reach while leaving

Goes across and heaves. Deep midwicket runs to the left, dives and pulls it in. Did his knee touch the cushion while he did it? Third ump checks it. Few replays taken, knees were buckled and it was close but not given a boundary

Wide given. Was that a no-ball? Might've landed outside the cut strip. Yep it did, but after going past the batter. Tewatia initially made room, then slid across following the ball. Let the thigh-high full toss, angling away, eventually
Tewatia doesn't miss out on the low full toss. No follow-through needed. Picks it up from the off-stump line, brings the bottom hand in and whooshes it over square. Stood deep in the crease too
Low fully, pace-on, might've been a missed yorker but it's slapped straight to sweeper cover. Got a bit of width too

Flayed off the thick outside edge, Curran runs to the left from deep-backward point. There was two on but Gill, smartly, settles for one and retains strike. Was a fullish wide cross-seamer. Gill tried to crunch it over point probably
Full and slow, fifth stump, driven to long-off
No, Vijay tries to go for the boundary but flat bats it to long-off. Good catch by Brar, running in and takes it while sliding into the ground. Was shortish, slow and a touch wide.
Wide and full, miscues it this time. Crowd, who were buzzing, go into a moment of silence. Gill tried to flap it over cover

Forehand is back, whiplashes in follow-through too. Hands and back leg in fact. Remarkable optics and hitting. Shortish and outside off, Gill manufacturing pace with pure muscle. Got it right behind the bowler too.

Slot. That's clobbered too! 134ks, fourth stump. Three-quarter length balls that rise to knee-roll height is free meat and drink for Gill. Goes deep in the crease and slugs it gracefully if that can be done
Similar ball. Pace on, jammed towards point
Yorker outside off, opens the face and steers it the gap on the offside

Gill, like Vijay, looks to go over long-on but also does it! 150 up for GT. Slower bumper again, around fifth stump, Gill stays back and munches it with a flat bat. It's like a forehand, minimal follow-through but his bat speed is next level. Into the Kings' dugout it goes. 79 metres
Slower bumper outside off, pulled to long-on. Vijay trying to manufacture power and take it over the leg side rather than guide it offside
Perfect yorker. All Gill can do is slide leg side and jam it to long-on. 137ks, the bat face flew inwards almost.
Slower bouncer just under the face, pulled into the ground to short fine. Tried to get it to the boundary probably but a single ain't too bad now
Full on middle, goes square-on and clips it to deep midwicket
Full at the stumps, clipped to deep midwicket
Overpitched on the stumps, clipped. Timing is terrific, he eased it but the ball raced across the outfield. Deep midwicket stops it with a dive to the right
Slower bumper is pulled to deep square leg. Comes around neck-height, gives it the full swivel but limits the power
Low fully on leg, 134ks, clipped along the ground to deep midwicket
Fulish outside off, 134ks, driven along the ground through cover. Gill holding his shape well again
Full around sixth, seemed slowish but 94ks, driven to long-on

Tad slower and straighter but Gill is still able to shovel it fine and off the back foot. Arshdeep running it to the right, splashed the ball in with both hands while maintaining no contact with the cushion. Saves one.

No one behind deep square and that's where Gill goes by using the pace and angle. Brings up fifty too, 31 balls, crowd appreciate it. Good chance to bat throughout. Was a tad short, darting down and he short-arm pulled it with great hand speed
Wide on the fuller side of length, 94ks, Gill chops it, might've premeditated that, to cover
Length on leg, clipped to deep-backward leg off the back foot
Ball hits a length, 94ks, outside off. Chopped to backward point
Fullish on leg, clipped to long-on. Timeout taken by GT

Has that been steered to the keeper? Jitesh goes big in appeal, Sudharsan walks. 128ks, shortish if not actually a bouncer. Line around fifth stump, height around the neck, the upper cut/ramp was attempted. He tried to go fine but got it off the cue end. Harshal did in fact put revs on it. Kudos to his fitness to bowl at that pace
Slower one beats the flashing cover drive. In Sudharsan's half, was angling away through fifth, he tried to go with high hand speed but couldn't make connection
Short-arm pull is back. 136ks, into the pitch, hit from around waist-height to deep midwicket
Fullish length ball around fourth, square driven to deep cover
Length around fifth, 135ks, clipped to long-on
Back of length, fifth stump, 142ks, dabbed off the back foot to deep third
Into the pitch, just outside off, helped to deep fine leg with a pull
This time is Sudharsan pumping length balls. Not as well timed but clears mid-off with ease.
Bashed into a length, just outside off, pushed towards cover
Pumping length balls through the line. That's elite stuff. It's around off, not much of a stride forward but the head is still and the balance is perfect. Holds the pose too
Length just outside off, square driven to deep point
Fullish on middle and leg, 96ks, clipped to long-on
Pulled through midwicket, winds up fully with the swivel. Picked off top of off, not without risk but Sudharsan reading length and taking initiative well.
Misses the line. On the pads, it's length but Sudharsan was so deep in the crease that he could get on one knee and semi-pull it through long leg
Munched to the legside off the back foot
Legbreak is a tad wide, Gill clears the front leg and flat-bats it between his partner and the ump. Races for four
Raza turns the pitch into a dart board. Top of a length, at the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
Curran back to left-arm fingerspinner mode. Lands it very full, 81ks, whipped along the ground to long-on
Short, pace on. Pulled from just below the shoulder, to long leg
Glanced off middle stump. Using the angle in too. Fullish wobble ball and just below knee-roll height, got it very fine
Slow on a length, 109ks angles in at the thigh pad. Sits up but a bit of extra bounce. Sudharsan goes full-swivel and tries to pull it hard and fine. Misses, gets hit
How slow was that? Just 81ks. Looked like a ball from Kuldeep, was fullish and on the pads, clipped to square leg
Length around fifth, guided to deep third
Tad shorter on the same line, 94ks, pulled to deep midwicket
Sits up and Sudarsan pulls it in the gap at cow corner. Tad back of length if at all, 93ks, angling in towards off. The batter was onto it early
Slows it down to 90ks, full and around off, pushed to the right of the bowler
Pulled to deep midwicket. Shortish on fourth, very flat at 100ks. Gill lunged his back a bit
Length at the stumps, clipped to midwicket
Short carrom ball at the stumps, not much bounce, short-arm pulled through midwicket
Late dab, very late actually. Length around sixth, uses the angle and slices it with a fully open bat face. Too straight for short third
Fullish ball is worked to long-on
Overpitched, thumped to the left of the diving short-cover fielder. 93ks outside off, nice lean towards the line and bat speed

Extra bounce gets him, the cut is edged to backward point. 91ks, wide on a length, Harpreet probably inviting Kane to go down the ground again. He stayed in the crease and tried to carve it with decent power. In fact, the line was around fifth stump, Williamson made room and tried to open up the offside with a cut
Kane makes the play, was going just over run a ball, now dances down and slaps it wide to the left of catching cover. It was shortish and wide, Brar probably saw him and went wide. Well timed
Length on fourth, 91ks, chopped into the ground, to point
Fullish on fourth, 138ks, punched firmly to cover. Kings take the timeout an over before it becomes mandatory
Into the pitch, leg-stump line, clipped to deep midwicket
Length on middle, Harshal's release is leading to a sharp angle. Clipped to long-on
Shortish ball is carved wide of deep third. It's on fifth stump and he used the pace well, cross-bat shot.

Kane makes room while charging, gets a 134ks length ball that he drives to mid-off. Aaron Finch read that perfectly on air. Said Harshal couldn't go full and Kane would try going up and over, which is what happened
Starts with the slow bouncer, 121ks, angling in at the body. Pulled to deep midwicket
Length on middle, 91ks, stays put in the crease and defensively punches it to cover
Full outside off, leans out and pushes it to cover
Tight two. Gill jogged the first and had to rush, Curran got the throw - on the bounce - a bit wide to the bowler.
Misfielded at short 45 by Prabhsimran, he attacked the ball by moving to the diagonal left but the ball spun the other way and went into the outfield. Was a length ball that was nurdled fine
Length around off, clipped to square leg
Fullish outside off, pushed to cover
Dances down, gets a bit of shortness and width. 130ks. Slapped but off the bottom-half of the bat to point
Fullish on middle, almost deadbats it behind. Maybe wanted to steer it to third but got it towards the keeper
On the slower side again but too full. Kohli-esque punch off the front foot wide of mid-off, from Kane
Slower one does Kane in. Bottom hand comes off as he looks to lift the fullish ball around off down the ground. Gets a leading edge that luckily clears cover
Thick outside edge, no slip, too fine for short third. Three-quarter length, not much bounce, Kane may have waited for it to arrive but got a bit too late on the full-fledged cover drive
Length on leg, beats the flick and hits high on the front pad. Deflects towards backward point
He's shaping for Test balls and getting them. Small shuffle across in the crease and defends it in front
Extra bounce off a hard length. 140ks. He shaped to turn it across the line but had to check the shot while showing the full bat face. Defended in front
Good single to mid-on. Length at the stumps, gently defended with a straightish bat
Inside edge. Tries to block the fullish at-the-stumps ball straight, with an angled bat, gets it wide of leg stump and towards fine leg

Dances down to create a fuller length, opens the face and square drives on the move. 138ks on a hard length, angling in to off, good ball. But the bounce is trustable here and Kane is good enough to guide it in the gap through cover point
Fullish on off, defended in front
No slip and that's where the edge flies.Length ball around fifth, Gill tried stirring it with the angle but got a top edge. Ballooned in the gap, lucky four. Excellent over from Arshdeep btw
Bit shorter and wider, gets upright and guides it away from the body, to deep third. That's his escape shot, innit?

Ooh, holds its line to beat the edge. Kane angles the bat and plays it close to the body, probably best he couldn't done while not nicking it. Impressive ball, three-quarter length, lands around off. Kane probs in doubt about playing it with the full face and angling it fine
Tries that dab but inside edges onto pad. Test length, around that six-metre mark, may have come back in a bit. So it hit the thick inside edge, around shoulder-height, and onto pad
Wide on a length, steered to deep-backward point
Fullish around fifth, solidly punched to cover

143ks. Skied, Dhawan takes it at mid-off. Fuller side of length, around middle stump, Saha tried turning it legside this time. Maybe go over the top, like he did last ball, but got a leading edge. Don't think he looked comfortable against high pace but 30 in three ain't too bad in the powerplay
Gets width, flashes. Saha's instincts are working fine. 137ks, fifth-stump line, three-quarter length, somewhat forced it but got it above the infield
Length at the stumps, blocked in front
Hits high on the sticker. Heart of a length, leg and middle line, Gill tried working it leg side but had to pull his glove late. Didn't pop high, luckily, went to the offside again
Gill doesn't miss out on the glance. This was three-quarter length and top of the pad, easier arguably
Good bounce. 137ks. Hard length, jumps up and Saha has to yank his back up too. Opens the bat face and taps the ball with soft hands to the off side
Called wide. Thought there was a deflection but no. Length ball, 136ks, thigh-pad height, angling down. Saha tried to glance it but got his bottom hand off
Gill dances down, gets bounced. 136ks, rises around chest-heigth, Gill has time to wait for a millisecond, pull it into the ground behind square. Deep fine leg runs across and slides to save a couple
Length around off, defended towards point
Half-volley on leg, clipped over forward square leg. Using the swing in his favour, Saha, lifted his back leg and had a small swipe
Fuller side of length, swinging in again. 132ks, around fifth stump, Saha looks to work it leg side, slightly away from the body but checks the shot

Jitesh was chasing it back, tripped in the outfield and a chunk of grass comes up. The ball meanwhile goes to the fence, too much for deep fine leg to do. Keeper removing his gloves led to losing balance. Was a length ball angling down that was glanced fine

Swings back in, hits pad. Lbw given, Saha reviews. 129ks, hit right on the top of the back pad. He was just outside the crease. Could height be an issue? Arshdeep's walking back towards his mark as ball-tracking loads up. Tad back of length in fact, lands around middle, and... is shown to be going over over leg stump. Cheers from the crowd.
Gill ruins what would've otherwise been a good over by dancing down and pumping it straight into the boundary cushion down the ground! Stood legside of the line and swung freely. 91ks
Full outside off, pushed to cover
Length on leg, goes across and nudges it towards short midwicket for a quick single
Length outside off, punched to the left of the bowler
Full outside off, driven to cover
Stops a bit in the pitch. Might be a good call to start with spin. Tad short of length, given some air, Saha checked the back-foot punch to the bowler

They steal a leg-bye and Kings stop Titans' home-run! Nalkande spears it full on pads, Shashank looks to flick but gets it off the pads. Saha dives and stops it but it is not enough to prevent the single. Titans review, but the impact is also outside leg

All the luck in the world is with Shashank tonight. Gets a leading edge that flies over point. He looks to whip a length ball across the line but gets the desired result. Not in the desired region though
Length ball on middle, off-pace, pulled to deep square leg. 117.1kph

Wide or no? Back of a length down leg, Brar gets in line but misses the pull. The umpire gives it wide but Titans review. Is it over his head as well? The TV ump does not think so. And he thinks the batter moved before the ball was bowled. So the wide call has been overturned
Banged short on leg, bounces way over Brar's head. Wide called

And CAN YOU BELIEVE IT Nalkande strikes first ball! Bowls it on a length well outside off, 109.5kph, Ashutosh has to fetch it from there as he looks to heave it across. Holes out to Rashid at long-on and he did not have to move an inch. Job done from Ashutosh though. Or so we think!

Game, set, match? Shashank once again connects one off the meat to set the cheers going in the Kings' camp. Stands still against the back of a length ball outside off, 115kph, and heaves it well over deep square leg
Full toss outside off, hit straight to sweeper cover
Low full toss just outside off, he gets across to scoop but gets it off the pads through square leg. The impact clearely was outside off and Titans do not review
Back of a length outside off, once again he goes back and across and hacks it across. Sai Sudharsan does well and keeps it to two
Ashutosh picks up the slower one and deposits it over deep midwicket. Slower one on a length well outside off, 101kph, he gets into position early and hacks it off the middle
Full on middle, knocked down to long-on

Another short ball, another four. Sunil Gavaskar on air does not understand the logic of Omarzai continuously bowling short without having the field for it. Ashutosh goes for the pull but gets a top edge well away from short fine leg. 16 off the over
Sai Sudharsan dives full length after getting to his right from long-off, fails to hang on. Full on off, smacked towards long-off but gets away
Yorker on off, dug out towards cover and gets to his maiden IPL fifty
Back of a length around off, he hits it through mid-on off the cue end
Ramped over the keeper now. Just the kind of start Kings needed. Omarzai bangs it short, in line of the stumps. Ashutosh jumps and gets it over the wicketkeeper
Greeted with a four! He goes for the wide yorker outside off, Ashutosh outthinks him. Walks across and sweeps it over square leg
Back of a length, outside off, looks like the slower one. Ashutosh waits before heaving it away towards deep midwicket. Yep, 116kph
Slower one, full outside off, he gets across, waits and then slaps it through cover. 99kph
Length ball outside off, slapped to sweeper cover

A lot of airtime for the ball.... and Umesh drops it. He gets around from deep square leg, has his eyes on the ball but fails to hang on. Ashutosh plays the no-look heave across the line but is lucky to get away
Back of a length just outside off, he looks to ramp it but misses
Back of a length on middle, 135.3kph, heaved through midwicket. They ran two but a short run has been signalled, so they get just one. Will it cost Kings?
Flatter and on a length, he turns it through square leg
Flatter and spinning in, he gets across but misses the flick
Edged to short third. Goes for the drive against a tossed up ball, off the mark

Rashid gets a wicket off a full toss! He cannot believe it. Gill knows it is a bonus. They share a laugh. Jitesh cannot believe what he has done and is down on his haunches. He gives it his all and only skies it to Nalkande at deep midwicket. Kings still in the game but they need someone to stay in with Shashank. This is Rashid's 50th wicket for Titans
This is even bigger. Stands on middle and off, gets a tossed up ball outside off. Gets down on a knee and slogs it over deep midwicket
Jitesh connects now! Flatter one on a length on off, he backs away, leans back and lofts it over long-off
Slower one well wide outside off, on a length as well, Shasnak moves towards the ball and looks to mow it but gets a thick inside edge towards the wicketkeeper

Tag-team effort at deep midwicket. Shashank moves across and flicks it through the on side. Sai Sudharsan gets across from deep midwicket, keeps the ball in the field of play, Vijay Shankar does the mopping up
Lofted over mid-off. Shashank is reading the bowler very well. Expects the length ball, gets one at 130.4kph, stands tall and hits it with a straight bat
Back of a length slower one, Shashank goes back to ramp it but is done in by the lack of pace
In the slot on middle and leg, Jitesh looks to go downtown but gets it off the inner half to deep midwicket
Back of a length around off, Jitesh lets that be
Picked up and deposited into the stands. Flighted full on middle, Shashank gets down on a knee and slog sweeps it over deep midwicket to enter the forties in style
Heaves the length ball to deep midwicket, hit him high on the bat
Flatter and on a length outside off, goes for a heave across the line but gets an outside edge to short third
Omarzai throws himself on the deep square leg boundary now. Saves two for sure. Googly on a length, he goes back and heaves it through the on side
Tossed up full on off, eased towards cover
Googly on a length on off and middle, he goes back and misses the flick
Fuller outside off, driven through cover,

Smartly played. Another bouncer just outside off, 130.4kph, Shashank makes use of the pace on offer. Moves across on off, arches back and then ramps it over the wicketkeeper. Third was also in the circle, so a safe option that
Length ball on leg, clipped through backward square leg for two
Gets away, Jitesh! Mohit surprises him with a bumper, he goes for the pull and it lands well short of fine leg running to he right
Gonzo! The length ball does it for Mohit. Hard length, Raza backs away and looks to slap it over cover. Only manages a thin outside edge to the wicketkeeper. Is that the telling blow?
Back of a length outside off, glides it wide of short third, 129.7kph
Slower through the air, on a length outside leg, he goes back and works it through midwicket with soft hands and collects two more
Tossed up full on leg, he misses the sweep and gets it off his pad to short fine leg
Powered away! Shortish, googly, angling away. Shashank goes back and heaves it away to beat long-on to his right
Flatter and spinning away, punched to short cover
On middle and leg, powers the swipe through midwicket. Nalkande does well in the deep to keep it to one
Fuller on off, swept through midwicket
Thick edge past short third. Runs are coming thick and fast now. Legcutter on a length outside off, 115.2kph, he goes for the slash but gets an outside edge
And now this goes the distance. Back of a length angling down leg, Shashank gets inside the line and swipes it over fine leg
Shashank connects. No chance for Omarzai in the deep. Back of a length well outside off, he cuts it through point
Now Omarzai grants Raza a life. He goes back to punch it over cover but gets a top edge towards deep point. Omarzai runs in but fails to hold on

Will go down as a dropped chance but it would have been a screamer. Length ball outside off, Raza gets across and looks to scoop it away. He does not connect well and it goes towards the right of short fine leg, where Noor dives full length but only manages to parry it away
Back of a length outside off, 137.5kph, he goes for the slap but misses
Fuller on the stumps, dug out towards the right of the bowler
Just over the leaping long-off. Shashank has had enough of prodding. Dances down to the wrong'un and tonks it straight over. Umesh jumps but it is well over him

Huge appeal from Noor, but umpire Menon unmoved. Gill immediately signals the 'T:! Tossed up around middle and leg, Shashank is unsure of which way the ball is turning. He presses forward to defend with a smallish stride and gets beaten on the inside edge. The bounce saves Shashank, and Gill and Titans cannot believe that
Flights it but bowls it down leg, he misses the tuck
Fuller on off, swept through square leg
Wrong'un, Raza did not pick that. On a length, landing on middle and leg and going the other way. Raza only follows the line of the ball and is beaten
Floated full on leg, swept through backward square leg for a couple
Goes back to the length ball and punches it through cover-point
Banged short but sliding down leg, he ducks under it
Lovely straight dive. Length ball outside off, 138.8kph, he moves across and drives it back between the stumps and the non-striker

Catching practice! Curran wanted to swivel and pull to exploit the space between deep square leg and long-on. But he does not manage to get the elevation. Omarzai bowls it on a shortish length on leg at 135.1kph, Curran swivels and hits it straight to Williamson at short midwicket
Length ball on middle and leg, he misses the flick and it rolls off his pads through square leg. 140.1kph
Length on middle, kept out to short midwicket
Back of a length outside off, cut away to backward point, where the fielder half-stops it with a dive
Fuller on muddle and leg, Raza leans forward and gets a thick inside edge to short fine leg. He did not pick that one
Spins away on a length outside off, he goes back and punches it to long-on
Quicker on a length, on middle and leg, once again sweeps it to fine leg
Full on off and middle, paddled through short fine

Flummoxed! Noor tosses up the googly around middle and off, Prabhsimran is early in backing away, and has made his mind to go across the line. All he manages is a top edge and Mohit at short third has hardly had to move. Kings slide steadily
Fuller and outside off, spinning away, punched to sweeper
Williamson dives to his right after getting across from short fine to save a certain four. Noor slips this down leg and it spins further away. Could have been five wides if not for KW
Fuller on middle and leg, he goes back and nudges it through midwicket
Fuller around off, goes for the drive but gets an inside edge through square leg. Hands on head for Rashid
Fuller outside off, hit to cover
Goes back and works away the length ball, the wrong one, through midwicket
Connects and connects well. Rashid goes full with his length, on leg, Prabhsimran backs away and slogs it over midwicket for a one-bounce four
Quicker and fuller outside off, 92.4kph, he stays back and looks to glide it but is beaten for pace
Spins in from a length outside off, punched to mid-on
Slower through the air, on a length on leg, tucked away through backward square leg
Full and down leg, Prabhsimran only has to make contact with the ball. He does by sweeping it wide of the keeper
Fuller on off, mistimed to mid-off
Fuller on off and middle, worked away through square leg

Cracker of a delivery! Noor is off. He tosses it up and lands it on a length outside leg. Bairstow completely misses the line of the ball and leaves a small gab between bat and pad. He was also on the move. That gap is enough for the ball to sneak through and deflect off the back pad to rattle the stumps. Another failure for YJB
Flighted full outside off, he moves across and sweeps it to short fine leg.
Once again backs away but cuts it to backward point
Deep midwicket moves to deep square leg. So there is enough room to exploit in the off side. And Prabhsimran backs away early. Rashid bowls it on a length on leg, he slaps it through cover-point
Spinning in from a length, he swipes it across the line through square leg. Sai Sudharsan rushes to his right in the deep, slides and keeps them to two
Flatter and on a length on the pads, he misses the tuck and it rolls off the thigh guard towards short fine
Quicker and on a length on middle and leg, turned away through midwicket for a brace
Seaming back in from a length outside off, 141.8kph, cramps Bairstow for room. He looks to punch it but gets a thick inside edge over leg stump, wide of the keeper
Back of a length on middle and leg, pulled to deep square leg
Length ball outside off, kept out to cover-point
Smacked straight over the bowler. Back of a length around off and middle, Prabhsimran comes down and hits it up and over
Outside off on a length, slapped straight to short cover, 138.6kph. Prabh feels he missed out there
Nonchalant flick! Length ball on middle at 140.2kph, Prabhsimran swings his bat nicely and deposits it over deep midwicket
A direct hit would have had Prabhsimran in trouble. He dances down to a length ball and hacks it to mid-on, and takes on the fielder. Makes it in eventually
Length ball around off, gets it wide of mid-on off the inner half
Length ball angling in, flicked to deep square leg
Outside off on a length, punched to mid-off
Thick edge but flies to deep third. Looks to turn a length ball at 140.4kph across the line
Cracking shot. Wide and full outside off, 141.1kph, Bairstow once again gets his stride out and drives it through extra cover
All timing, helped by Umesh's pace. Back of a length around off, Prabhsimran stands tall and pulls it all along the ground, well wide of mid-on
On a length outside off, punched to short cover, 138.7kph
Length ball around off and middle, defended towards mid-on
Good length ball around off and middle, he pushes it straight back past the bowler and immediately calls through for a run. Prabhsimran is a tad late to respond but does so eventually
Length ball on the pads, clipped through backward square leg
